statement: Let n = len(nums). For 0 <= k < n, let L(k) = sum of nums[i] for 0 <= i < k (empty sum 0) and R(k) = sum of nums[i] for k < i < n (empty sum 0). The function returns a result r and exactly one of the following holds: (a) r = -1 and for every k with 0 <= k < n, L(k) != R(k); (b) 0 <= r < n, L(r) = R(r), and for every k with 0 <= k < r, L(k) != R(k).
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 100 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -1000 <= nums[i] <= 1000.
